model.title: American Decade of Sports Act
model.meta: Foreign Relations Committee · Sen. Jacky Rosen (D-NV)

summary.text: The bill would require the federal government to develop a strategy for using major sporting events hosted in the United States over the coming decade as tools to strengthen American diplomatic relationships and global influence around the world.
